## Features
- Tree skirt not included
- Beautiful lifelike look and feel
- Naturally bushy branches
- Easy to assemble
- Green stand included

## Information
Create a timeless festive centrepiece with this elegant Fraser Fir Artificial Christmas Tree from Christow. With its tapered shape and thickly layered branches, the Fraser Fir has a dense, full-bodied look. Lifelike PE and PVC tips add natural texture, giving the tree a beautifully bushy finish. The tree comes in three sections with hinged branches, twist-and-lock poles, and a sturdy metal stand for easy setup and styling. Instructions are included to guide you every step of the way. Crafted with a higher ratio of PVC to PE tips, the Fraser Fir has a naturally bushy look with lifelike texture and detail. The PE tips add realism while the PVC tips fill out the branches for a dense, traditional look that captures the charm of a real fir tree. The tree features hinged branches for a faster setup and styling. Simply pull the branches down and fluff them out for a beautifully layered look. Sturdy and well-spaced, they provide plenty of hanging space for your favourite decorations.
